Sweden.deficit: Eurostat gov_10q_ggdebt/gov_10q_ggnfa · general government, % of GDP, quarterly.

Switzerland.gdp_level: World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.CD · current US$, annual -- this is the only live source for Switzerland's nominal GDP, so it's shown in its native currency (USD) rather than converted.
Switzerland.gdp_real: FRED series CLVMNACSAB1GQCH · Eurostat, quarterly, seasonally adjusted. Switzerland is not an EU member but this series is Eurostat-sourced via a bilateral data-sharing arrangement, unlike the IMF IFS series used for most other non-EU pages on this site.
Switzerland.gdp_growth: FRED series CLVMNACSAB1GQCH · Eurostat, quarterly, quarter-on-quarter.
Switzerland.cpi: OECD live prices system · CPI, all items, year on year.
Switzerland.unemployment: FRED series LRUNTTTTCHQ156S · OECD, seasonally adjusted, quarterly. Note: the LRHUTTTT-prefixed series used on most other pages here is explicitly marked discontinued for Switzerland -- this is the OECD's replacement series.
Switzerland.business_confidence: OECD · Business Confidence Indicator (BCICP), amplitude-adjusted, long-term average = 100.
Switzerland.debt_gdp: FRED series DEBTTLCHA188A · World Bank World Development Indicators, central government debt, % of GDP, annual.

Thailand.gdp_level: World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.CN.AD · GDP, current prices, linked series, local currency units, annual (falls back to World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, current US$, only if the THB linked series is unavailable this run).
Thailand.gdp_growth: World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.KN · GDP, constant prices, local currency units, annual (same basis as gdp_level). Switched from Penn World Table's PPP-benchmarked rgdpna in a prior session, which produced a distorted “real GDP” figure roughly 2.6x nominal when substituted into the level card.
Thailand.cpi: OECD live prices system · CPI, all items, year on year.
Thailand.unemployment: World Bank SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS · modeled ILO estimate, % of total labour force, annual.
Thailand.business_confidence: OECD · Business Confidence Indicator (BCICP), amplitude-adjusted, long-term average = 100.
Thailand.debt_gdp: FRED series DEBTTLTHA188A · World Bank World Development Indicators, central government debt, % of GDP, annual.

Turkey.gdp_level: FRED series NGDPSAXDCTRQ · IMF International Financial Statistics, trailing 4-quarter sum (falls back to World Bank current US$, annual, only if the live TRY series is unavailable on a given run).
Turkey.gdp_real: FRED series NGDPRSAXDCTRQ · IMF International Financial Statistics, quarterly, seasonally adjusted.
Turkey.gdp_growth: FRED series NGDPRSAXDCTRQ · IMF International Financial Statistics, quarterly.
Turkey.cpi: OECD live prices system · CPI, all items, year on year.
Turkey.unemployment: FRED series LRHUTTTTTRM156S · OECD harmonized, seasonally adjusted, monthly.
Turkey.participation_rate: FRED series LRAC64TTTRQ156S · OECD, ages 15-64, seasonally adjusted, quarterly.
Turkey.business_confidence: OECD · Business Confidence Indicator (BCICP), amplitude-adjusted, long-term average = 100.
Turkey.debt_gdp: FRED series GGGDTATRA188N · IMF World Economic Outlook, general government, % of GDP, annual.
Turkey.deficit: FRED series GGNLBATRA188N · IMF World Economic Outlook, general government, % of GDP, annual.

US.gdp_level: FRED series GDP · nominal, seasonally adjusted annual rate (BEA).
US.gdp_real: FRED series GDPC1 · chained 2017 dollars, seasonally adjusted annual rate (BEA).
US.gdp_growth: FRED series A191RL1Q225SBEA · chained 2017 dollars, quarter-on-quarter annualised rate (BEA).
US.productivity: FRED series OPHNFB · nonfarm business output per hour, index (BLS).
US.cpi: Calculated from FRED series CPIAUCSL · all items, seasonally adjusted (BLS).
US.core_cpi: Calculated from FRED series CPILFESL · seasonally adjusted (BLS).
US.fed_funds: FRED series FEDFUNDS · effective rate, monthly average.
US.business_confidence: OECD · Business Confidence Indicator (BCICP), amplitude-adjusted, long-term average = 100.
US.fdi: World Bank · FDI net inflows, % of GDP, annual (sourced from IMF balance-of-payments data).
US.current_account: World Bank · % of GDP, annual (IMF balance-of-payments data).
US.trade_balance: FRED series BOPGSTB · goods and services, seasonally adjusted (BEA/Census).
US.exports: FRED series BOPTEXP · goods and services, seasonally adjusted (BEA/Census).
US.imports: FRED series BOPTIMP · goods and services, seasonally adjusted (BEA/Census).
US.trade_intensity: Calculated from FRED series BOPTEXP, BOPTIMP and GDP · complete calendar years only.
US.debt_gdp: FRED series GFDEGDQ188S · total public debt, % of GDP (Treasury/OMB).
US.net_debt: FRED series GFDEBTN · total public debt (Treasury).
US.deficit: FRED series MTSDS133FMS · Monthly Treasury Statement.
